title: In SUMMARIZECOLUMNS, ALLSELECTED inside an iteration restores the iteration's shadow; outside it, the selection
query: "Correct", VAR Total = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], ALLSELECTED () ) RETURN SUMX ( 'Product', Total )

source.quote: Because SUMX iterates over the products of the given brand, TotalSales calculates the sales of all products in the currently-displayed brand.
source.supports: the Wrong column: inside SUMX over Product, ALLSELECTED restores the products the iteration iterates

source.quote: It removes the filter over Product[Brand], making all products visible
source.supports: the Correct column: outside the iteration, ALLSELECTED removes the group-by filter

derivation: Accessories: Helmet (60) and Lock (80), 140; Vehicles: Bike (400) and Scooter (no sales), 400; total 540. Wrong: for each of a category's two products, ALLSELECTED restores the iterated products of the category: Accessories 2 x 140 = 280, Vehicles 2 x 400 = 800. Correct: the variable is the total with the category's filter removed, 540, summed over two products: 1080.
